sleeping_bag.name: X-LITE 300
sleeping_bag.subtitle: extremely light 2-3 season down sleeping bag
sleeping_bag.description: Cumulus presents the X-Lite series as the lightest sleeping bags in the world by weight-to-warmth ratio. The X-LITE 300 combines 19 g/m2 Toray Airtastic fabric, a slim fit, a 3 mm 2/3 YKK zip, a shark-fin footbox and a 3D hood with ethically sourced 900 FP Polish goose down. The design is deliberately minimalist but intended to remain comfortable and highly compressible.
sleeping_bag.key_features:
- 465 g total weight
- 300 g of 900 FP ethically sourced Polish goose down
- Comfort 2 C / limit -4 C
- Toray Airtastic 19 g/m2 shell and liner
- 3 mm YKK 2/3 zip with 2 self-locking sliders
- Trapezoidal chambers
- Differential cut
- 3D hood with 2 drawcords
- Anatomical shark-fin footbox
- Customizable via configurator
sleeping_bag.manufacturer_claims: Weight reduction is presented as Cumulus's main mission. The bag is marketed as extremely light, compact, and intended for users who want compact gear without compromising on performance.
sleeping_bag.ideal_for: Fast-paced users, compact gear focused travel, trail running, ultramarathons, bikepacking, sport rock climbing.
